text:
𝗝𝗔𝗬 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗛 𝗥𝗘-𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗜𝗡𝗧𝗘𝗗! 🏏

The ICC Board has confirmed Jay Shah for a second term as ICC Chairman, unopposed.
His first term began on 1 Dec 2024. Olympic cricket at LA 2028 is the priority.

Right call? 👇
#ICC #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗝𝗔𝗬 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗛 𝗗𝗨𝗦𝗥𝗜 𝗕𝗔𝗔𝗥 𝗜𝗖𝗖 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗜𝗥𝗠𝗔𝗡! 🏏

👉 ICC Board ne Jay Shah ko second term ke liye confirm kiya
👉 Unke khilaaf koi rival nomination nahi aaya
👉 Pehla term 1 Dec 2024 ko shuru hua tha
👉 LA 2028 Olympics mein cricket unki badi priority hai

Aapko kya lagta hai, sahi faisla? Comment karo 👇
#CricketKiBaat #ICC #JayShah
